positive_design_findings: Exact0.6.1/repaired-source identities with common CLI0.5.5 host and package0.7.2 retained; repaired source hash, not a release-version claim, identifies the successor.
Fresh disjoint authorship follows complete M0; corpus M1 precedes first-only execution; old first observations/labels/scorers stay immutable.
Case quality P.95/R.85/F1.90 and gain2 remain prospective, provider/track separated, with hard safety/regressions mandatory; claim F1 is distinct.
External full-context/all-display independent-agent annotations are named as agent, not human, and candidate models have no scoring authority.
Logical operations, adapter generations, HTTP attempts and aggregate tokens are explicitly different budgets; unknown usage does not become zero/refund.
Actual Docker image digest fixed before M0 and reused at M1 is a sound proposed closure mechanism, subject to D5.

must_resolve_before_M0.scope: required pre-M0 classification and track definition
must_resolve_before_M0.finding: Fully grounded/cited/useful success must not erase an unsafe attempted answer by converting its predicted acceptance to false. An unsafe affirmative answer to a clear negative cannot thereby become TN. Ambiguous cases remain outside the existing binary denominator while unsafe acceptance is retained as a separate hard failure.
must_resolve_before_M0.required_resolution: Freeze executable row tables for clear positive, clear negative, ambiguous and operationally incomplete. Specify actual assertion/acceptance versus useful/authorized success flags and exact TP/FP/FN/TN mapping, including unsupported output on a clear positive. Every unsupported/unsafe acceptance remains a hard violation even if another quality flag is false. Preserve normal useful-answer and helper authorized scoped-display positive classes separately; unresolved semantic adjudication remains incomplete.
must_resolve_before_M0.not_a_new_requirement: This resolves the existing positive/negative/ambiguous and hard-safety contract; no threshold or new gold is added.

existing_contract.zero_or_missing_baseline_denominator: NO_GO pending a separately precommitted successor protocol, never assume zero cost

must_resolve_before_M0.finding: Median call/token ratios are different from the old mean added model-call ceiling and aggregate token ratio. They can hide tail work; matching numeric1.25 does not make the statistics equivalent.
must_resolve_before_M0.required_resolution: Retain mean candidate model calls added per task<=1 and aggregate candidate/baseline tokens<=1.25 as the existing comparison gates, with medians as diagnostics; or explicitly approve a prospective successor replacement/crosswalk before M0 and authoring. Do not silently claim unchanged efficiency requirements. Freeze logical-operation versus adapter-generation call units, p95 estimator, ratio-of-statistics versus statistic-of-paired-ratios and zero/missing handling.
must_resolve_before_M0.not_a_new_requirement: No new efficiency threshold is requested. The issue is incompatible statistics and omitted old definitions.

must_resolve_before_M0.finding: The brief says separate24 normal and24 helper questions, while cases24 and minimum_complete_rows24 do not specify whether an observation is a case, pair or arm row.
must_resolve_before_M0.required_resolution: State cases_per_track=24 and complete paired cases_per_provider_track=24, each with baseline24 and candidate24 rows. The stated 3providers×2tracks×2arms×24 implies288 planned arm observations, not288 independent documents. Specify whether cross-track questions are distinct and report unique questions/documents/origins separately. Freeze arm order, same source order/as-of/settings and keyed joins; no pooling or missing arm can pass.
must_resolve_before_M0.not_a_new_requirement: This spells out the already requested sample/pairing size without demanding more questions or independent documents.

must_resolve_before_M0.existing_contract: metrics preparation lines35-45,54-65; protocol minimum gain2 and separate helper/normal tracks
must_resolve_before_M0.finding: undefined_metric_passes=false and citation gate1 need explicit level/applicability. A correct no-assertion withholding or cited paraphrase with no literal quotations must not be forced to invent claims/quotes to satisfy a per-case rate. Conversely undefined aggregate required quality cannot be treated as perfect.
must_resolve_before_M0.required_resolution: Apply claim micro gates per required candidate provider/track over the same complete reviewed cohort; retain individual nulls/denominators and all planned rows. Citation precision/coverage audit actual displayed edges/required asserted propositions; zero asserted claims is N/A rather than perfect and withholding is judged separately. Literal quote fidelity applies to actual literal quotes, with no-quote N/A (or predeclare an explicit quotation requirement, never add one after observation). Define normal net gain as fixed complete useful answers with answerable requested facets, excluding refusal-explanation-only or helper credit; define helper net authorized scoped-display gain with valid prebinding/authority. Preserve losses and positive regressions.
must_resolve_before_M0.not_a_new_requirement: This implements existing null/useful-answer and citation definitions, without changing the supplied thresholds.

must_resolve_before_M0.finding: An immutable Docker runtime is an appropriate dependency carrier but does not itself bind M1 files, host mounts/environment, provider settings or the actual measured API path. The draft also lacks explicit old settings/arm order inherited by reference.
must_resolve_before_M0.required_resolution: M0 must include the actual OCI digest/platform and build/source/binary receipts for both arms, exact shared request-cap/audit patch, entrypoints and allowed external config/secret/mount interfaces. Bind M1 inputs/full sources/gold/output policy by readonly manifests to the unchanged image; forbid mutable-tag rebuilds and unlisted executable mounts. Freeze all actual model settings/default serialization/seed/output formats and arm order. Verify before fresh authoring that the declared normal/active/helper/renderer profile measures its claimed path. The same serialized-request cap must cover all provider payload inputs, and the bytes+2048 token bound/currency-category mapping must be justified and enforced before each attempt.
must_resolve_before_M0.not_a_new_requirement: These are existing dependency/request/path/budget freeze duties, not a demand for a new feature, expanded budgets or an extra acceptance experiment. No image/build/price/model availability was independently verified in this design-only review.

must_resolve_before_M0.finding: Groq new_live_run_allowed=false and cap0 correctly preserve the prohibition, so an executable complete three-provider M0 is not ready today. User-reported full allowance does not itself rewrite the latch or establish the exact tier/price/reserve.
must_resolve_before_M0.required_resolution: Keep starts0. Resolve authorized recovery, exact provider/model/tier, quota/headroom and numeric reservation policy before closing the runnable all-three M0, or leave this plan blocked before fresh authorship. Do not silently drop Groq or alter its budget/model/tier after authoring under the same freeze. If a conditional authorization mechanism is used, all nonzero bounds and state-transition rules must already be frozen and independently reviewed.
must_resolve_before_M0.not_a_new_requirement: This preserves the existing all-required-provider and no-switch/no-retry contract. This review does not authorize Groq recovery.

not_requested: No new threshold, source case, gold, arbitrary-language capability, provider switch, post-measurement endpoint or historical rescore.
No requirement that medians replace old aggregate/mean gates or that every answer contain a quotation.
No implicit increase from the six-logical-operation bound or rescue after a failed first run.
review_boundary: Prospective protocol design only. This is not implementation review, Docker/runtime/price/headroom validation, completed M0, real answer F1, provider execution, human evaluation or release/CLI acceptance.
